notes.key_messages:
The question paper requires answers to be written in dark blue or black ink, the use of pencils by candidates
in writing formulae, structures and equations is to be strongly discouraged. Pencilled text is sometimes too
faint to read and also some candidates write over the pencil in ink so that their answers become illegible.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates need to show clear working in mathematical questions, as where a final answer is incorrect often
credit can be obtained from correct working.
